McDonald's Collection 2022

Released August 3, 2022 · 15 cards

McDonald's Collection 2022 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on August 3, 2022. It has 15 cards. It includes 15 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
